questions.stem: The student wants to explain why urban hives outproduced rural hives in the 2020 survey. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
questions.subject: READING_WRITING
questions.passage:
A student is writing about urban beekeeping and has taken the following notes:

  • Urban beekeeping has grown rapidly in city centers over the past decade.
  • A 2020 city survey found rooftop hives in downtown areas produced 30% more honey per hive than rural hives in the same region.
  • Researchers attribute the difference to the greater diversity of flowering plants in urban parks and gardens compared to rural monoculture farmland.
  • Rural hives near large single-crop farms had access to only one or two flowering plant species during peak season.
  • Urban hives had access to dozens of flowering species across parks, gardens, and street trees.

choices.label: A
choices.content: Urban beekeeping has become increasingly popular in city centers over the past ten years.

choices.label: B
choices.content: A 2020 survey found that rooftop hives downtown produced 30% more honey per hive than rural hives in the same region.

choices.label: C
choices.content: Rural hives were located near large farms that grew only a single crop.

choices.label: D
choices.content: A 2020 survey found that urban hives, which had access to dozens of flowering plant species compared to the one or two available to rural hives near monoculture farms, produced more honey.
